title: Kalshi Pushes Deeper Into Crypto Derivatives With Bitcoin-Backed Margin Loans
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Kalshi Pushes Deeper Into Crypto Derivatives With Bitcoin-Backed Margin Loans A new tri-party lending structure with BitGo lets Kalshi Prime clients borrow against bitcoin to margin perpetual futures. This post Kalshi Pushes Deeper Into Crypto Derivatives With Bitcoin-Backed Margin Loans first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
